fact: The 'tail of the Lion' — a fast-spinning young white star with a disk of dust.
bio: Denebola (Beta Leonis) is a white main-sequence star just 36 light-years away, marking the tail of Leo the Lion. It rotates quickly and is surrounded by a disk of cool debris left over from planet-building.
cultural: The name comes from the Arabic 'dhanab al-asad', 'the tail of the lion'. In older astrology it was considered a star of ill fortune, in contrast to the regal Regulus at the Lion's heart.
